THE QUIRK: cJSON_GetArrayItem is NOT array-only. cJSON.c:1869 walks `array->child` with no type check, so index 0 of an OBJECT returns its first VALUE. The port's get_array_item asserted array-only in its own doc comment and answered None; nothing disagreed for six gates because no mode called it
the same child-list walk hands back a whole nested object, printed
index 2 of an object is its third value -- insertion order, the C's sibling chain
the mirror case: an object lookup on an array root answers NULL, because get_object_item DOES type-check
ordinary array indexing, plus GetStringValue returning the element's text
